judge: The agent completed most of the required tasks but had some significant issues. It checked MyBank credit card transactions and found Netflix ($15.99/mo) and Spotify Premium ($10.99/mo). It checked MegaMart order history but found no Subscribe & Save items. It created a 'Subscriptions' row in CloudSheets (row 8 with 'Subscriptions' in A8 and 55.96 in B8). It created a 'Subscription Audit' note in Notes with each subscription, cost, and keep/cancel recommendation. However, there are issues: (1) The total of $55.96 doesn't add up correctly - Netflix $15.99 + YouTube Premium $13.99 + Spotify Premium $10.99 + Apple Music $10.99 + GitHub Pro $4.00 = $55.96, which is correct mathematically. (2) The agent didn't fully explore MegaMart's Subscribe & Save section specifically - it only looked at order history without checking a dedicated Subscribe & Save section. (3) The CloudSheets row was added but the value 55.96 was placed in B8 without the label 'Subscriptions' being confirmed as saved in A8 - though screenshot 38 shows both A8='Subscriptions' and B8=55.96. (4) The agent reported subscriptions to the user in the final answer. Overall the task was substantially completed with the main deliverables created, though the MegaMart check was incomplete and the total calculation methodology was questionable (the agent seemed to derive subscriptions from multiple sources but the final list appears reasonable based on what was found).
